title: Japanese Tourists Are the Most Polite — Survey
paragraphs: Which tourists have the best manners? A new survey says it is the Japanese.
The survey was done by SafariBookings, a website for safari trips in Africa. It asked 192 tour companies in Africa five questions about their customers. The results came out in August 2026.

The companies were asked which tourists are the most polite. Japanese tourists were first. They got 21.1% of the answers. Tourists from Norway were second, with 10.6%. Tourists from Switzerland were third, with 10.4%. Canadians and Americans came next. Italian tourists were last, with only 1.3%.

The survey also asked other questions. For example, it asked which tourists leave the biggest tips. Americans were first, with 29.5%. Germans were second, and Canadians were third. Americans also spend the most money on their trips.
The companies also said that German tourists are the most adventurous. French and Dutch tourists came next.
Which tourists like food the most? Tourists from India were first, and Japanese tourists were second.
But the survey was small. Only 192 companies answered the questions, and they all work in Africa. So, the results may not be true for tourists everywhere.
In a different poll by the money transfer company Remitly, people were asked which country has the most polite people. Japan was first again. About 35% of people chose it.

On a safari, tourists often go on game drives. A game drive is a trip by car to see wild animals, such as lions and elephants. Guides spend many hours with their customers, so they can learn a lot about them.
